verses.original: הַֽלְלוּ־ יָ֡הּ הַלְלִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Praise the LORD O my soul -

verses.original: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
verses.literal: I will praise the LORD all my life I will sing praises to my God while I have my being

verses.original: אַל־ תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִנְדִיבִ֑ים בְּבֶן־ אָדָ֓ם׀ שֶׁ֤אֵֽין ל֥וֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ḇin·ḏî·ḇîm bə·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām še·’ên lōw ṯə·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: Put not your trust in princes in mortal man who cannot save

verses.original: ר֭וּחוֹ תֵּצֵ֣א יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָת֑וֹ הַ֝ה֗וּא בַּיּ֥וֹם עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃ אָבְד֥וּ
verses.transliteration: rū·ḥōw tê·ṣê yā·šuḇ lə·’aḏ·mā·ṯōw ha·hū bay·yō·wm ‘eš·tō·nō·ṯāw ’ā·ḇə·ḏū
verses.literal: When his spirit departs he returns to the ground on that very day his plans perish

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֗י בְּעֶזְר֑וֹ שֶׁ֤אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב שִׂ֝בְר֗וֹ עַל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.literal: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob whose hope is in the LORD his God

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה׀ שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ הַיָּ֥ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֑ם הַשֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- hay·yām wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- bām haš·šō·mêr ’ĕ·meṯ lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: the Maker of heaven and earth - the sea - and everything - in them He remains faithful forever

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט׀ לָעֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָרְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ lā·‘ă·šū·qîm nō·ṯên le·ḥem lā·rə·‘ê·ḇîm Yah·weh mat·tîr ’ă·sū·rîm
verses.literal: He executes justice for the oppressed [and] gives food to the hungry The LORD sets the prisoners {free}

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh pō·qê·aḥ ‘iw·rîm Yah·weh zō·qêp̄ kə·p̄ū·p̄îm Yah·weh ’ō·hêḇ ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: the LORD opens [the eyes of] the blind the LORD lifts those who are weighed down the LORD loves the righteous

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת־ גֵּרִ֗ים יְעוֹדֵ֑ד יָת֣וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֣ה וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šō·mêr ’eṯ- gê·rîm yə·‘ō·w·ḏêḏ yā·ṯō·wm wə·’al·mā·nāh wə·ḏe·reḵ rə·šā·‘îm yə·‘aw·wêṯ
verses.literal: The LORD protects - foreigners He sustains the fatherless and the widow but the ways of the wicked He frustrates

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה׀ יִמְלֹ֤ךְ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yim·lōḵ lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ĕ·lō·ha·yiḵ ṣî·yō·wn lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: The LORD reigns forever . . . your God O Zion for all generations . . . Hallelujah . . .
